title: Interpretable Multimodal MRI-Clinical Fusion for Functional Outcome Prediction After Acute Ischemic Stroke
abstract: arXiv:2611.08154v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study evaluates the added prognostic value of day-1 multimodal MRI for predicting three-month functional outcome after acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Sixty-six AIS patients with ADC, DWI, FLAIR, and clinical data were analyzed. Three-dimensional pretrained ResNet embeddings were extracted from each MRI modality, reduced using fold-isolated principal component analysis, and combined with structured clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers. Linear support vector machines were evaluated using eight-fold stratified group cross-validation across MRI modality combinations. Clinical-only modeling achieved strong performance (AUC = $0.899 \pm 0.151$), while MRI-only models showed limited discrimination (AUC $\approx$ $0.67$-$0.73$). Among multimodal configurations, FLAIR-clinical fusion achieved the highest mean cross-validated performance (AUC = $0.948 \pm 0.061$), followed by ADC-clinical fusion (AUC = $0.941 \pm 0.094$). Full

translated_title: 可解释的多模态MRI-临床数据融合用于急性缺血性卒中后功能结局预测
translated_abstract: 本研究评估了发病第1天多模态MRI对预测急性缺血性卒中（AIS）后三个月功能结局的额外预后价值。研究分析了66名具有ADC、DWI、FLAIR及临床数据的AIS患者。研究从每种MRI模态中提取三维预训练ResNet嵌入特征，使用折间隔离的主成分分析进行降维，并与结构化临床变量及ADC衍生的病灶生物标志物相结合。在多种MRI模态组合上，采用八折分层分组交叉验证评估线性支持向量机的性能。仅使用临床数据的模型取得了较强的性能（AUC = 0.899 ± 0.151），而仅使用MRI的模型判别能力有限（AUC ≈ 0.67-0.73）。在多模态配置中，FLAIR-临床融合取得了最高的平均交叉验证性能（AUC = 0.948 ± 0.061），其次是ADC-临床融合（AUC = 0.941 ± 0.094）。
tldr: 该研究提出一种可解释的多模态MRI与临床数据融合方法，证明FLAIR-临床融合（AUC=0.948）能显著提升急性缺血性卒中后三个月功能结局的预测性能。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an interpretable multimodal MRI-clinical fusion approach, demonstrating that FLAIR-clinical fusion (AUC=0.948) substantially improves prediction of three-month functional outcomes after acute ischemic stroke.
